**What's new in 2.1**

- A new, simpler window: files on the left with a picture of their pages, where everything goes on the right.
- Each destination has its own button again: *Print* for A4 and A3, *Plot* for the plotter. A print started while another one runs waits its turn.
- The plotter, roll by roll: pick the roll that is loaded; SPrint shows what is left and which roll comes next.
- The printer and its settings (⚙) are in each card; printers are found automatically the first time.
- Drawings print at real size (1:1) whenever only empty margin falls outside what the printer can reach.
- Visible signatures and filled-in form fields are printed.
- Pages smaller than A4 (A5, A6, …) can go to the A4 printer or the plotter's 297 mm roll.
- Two-sided printing for A4 and A3, leaving out single pages, a large page preview when the mouse rests on a page.
- Updating from 2.0 removes the old program files first (this fixes an error at start).

**Novo u 2.1**

- Novi, jednostavniji prozor: lijevo datoteke sa sličicama stranica, desno kamo što ide.
- Svako odredište opet ima svoj gumb: *Ispiši* za A4 i A3, *Plotaj* za ploter. Ispis pokrenut dok drugi traje čeka na red.
- Ploter rolu po rolu: odaberite rolu koja je stavljena; SPrint pokazuje što je ostalo i koja je rola sljedeća.
- Pisač i njegove postavke (⚙) su u svakoj kartici; pisači se prvi put prepoznaju sami.
- Crteži se ispisuju u stvarnoj veličini (1:1) kad god izvan dosega pisača ostaje samo prazna margina.
- Ispisuju se i vidljivi potpisi i popunjena polja obrazaca.
- Stranice manje od A4 (A5, A6, …) mogu na A4 pisač ili na ploter (rola 297).
- Obostrani ispis za A4 i A3, preskakanje pojedinih stranica, veliki pregled stranice kad zadržite miš na njoj.
- Nadogradnja s 2.0 prvo uklanja stare datoteke programa (to popravlja grešku pri pokretanju).
